disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源代码文件（src/ 目录下所有 .ts/.tsx 文件），无任何读取敏感路径（凭据文件、SSH 密钥、云服务凭据）的代码。
checked_items.en: All source code files (all .ts/.tsx files under src/ directory) were inspected, and no code reading sensitive paths (credential files, SSH keys, cloud service credentials) was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了拼写与语义匹配「凭据」「密钥」「token」「password」「secret」等关键词的所有位置，仅发现 token 用量统计（TokenUsage 类型）与模型路由字段，非凭据窃取。
checked_items.en: All positions matching keywords such as "credentials", "secrets", "token", "password", "secret" were checked for spelling and semantics. Only token usage statistics (TokenUsage type) and model routing fields were found, not credential theft.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖项与安装脚本，无凭据枚举命令（如 grep -R API_KEY、find ~ 等）。
checked_items.en: Dependencies and install scripts were inspected. No credential enumeration commands (e.g., grep -R API_KEY, find ~) were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现凭据文件读取代码。插件不读取 $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml 或任何敏感路径。质量测试脚本显式创建隔离环境并过滤所有凭据变量（scripts/quality/common.mjs:58-66）。
evidence.en: No credential file reading code was detected. The plugin does not read $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml or any sensitive paths. The quality test script explicitly creates an isolated environment and filters all credential variables (scripts/quality/common.mjs:58-66).

checked_items.zh: 审查了工具注册（dispatch_to_squad）的描述文字，描述为「Dispatch a task to a configured agent squad. Use assignments when particular members should do different work.」，无注入类措辞。
checked_items.en: The description of the tool registration (dispatch_to_squad) was reviewed. The description is "Dispatch a task to a configured agent squad. Use assignments when particular members should do different work.", containing no injection-like wording.

checked_items.zh: 审查了系统提示注入点，插件通过系统提示片段接口注入了 squad 模式引导文本（src/index.ts:71-75），内容为引导模型使用 squad 模式的业务说明，不含指令覆写、凭据诱导或越权指令。
checked_items.en: System prompt injection points were reviewed. The plugin injects squad mode guidance text via the system prompt fragment interface (src/index.ts:71-75). The content is business instructions guiding the model to use squad mode, containing no instruction override, credential inducement, or privilege escalation commands.

checked_items.zh: 审查了插件输出到模型上下文的渲染函数，包含回顾性分析模板和结构化输出指导，但均为插件核心业务（多模型 squad 编排）的预期行为，无恶意措辞。
checked_items.en: The rendering functions that output plugin content to the model context were reviewed. They include retrospective analysis templates and structured output guidance, but these are expected behaviors of the plugin's core business (multi-model squad orchestration) and contain no malicious wording.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 README、文档、代码注释，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、隐藏 HTML 指令、远程指令加载等注入模式。
checked_items.en: README, documentation, and code comments were reviewed. No injection patterns such as instruction override, system message masquerading, hidden HTML instructions, or remote instruction loading were found.

evidence.zh: 工具 dispatch_to_squad 的描述为正常业务描述。系统提示片段注入的 squad 模式引导文本（src/tools/application/definition-service.ts:700-733）为 squad 编排的业务指令，无注入攻击。
evidence.en: The description of the tool dispatch_to_squad is normal business description. The squad mode guidance text injected via system prompt fragment (src/tools/application/definition-service.ts:700-733) is business instructions for squad orchestration, not injection attacks.

evidence.zh: 工具描述中无诱导安装或改写配置的措辞。README 中的安装说明为标准 dsh 插件安装命令（github:toolclub/dsh-agent-team-gui#v1.0.1），无隐蔽引导。
evidence.en: No wording in tool descriptions induces installation or configuration rewriting. The installation instructions in README are standard dsh plugin installation commands (github:toolclub/dsh-agent-team-gui#v1.0.1), with no covert guidance.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源代码（src/）中是否存在动态求值、外部进程调用、编码解码后执行等危险模式，结果为无命中。
checked_items.en: All source code (src/) was checked for dangerous patterns such as dynamic evaluation, external process invocation, and execution after encoding/decoding. No hits were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁（cordis.patch.yml）中是否存在可执行脚本标量，结果为无。PLAN.md 中的 !!js 出现在文档代码块示例中（第 298 行），并非实际加载的补丁文件。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration (cordis.patch.yml) was checked for executable script scalars. None were found. The !!js in PLAN.md appears in a documentation code block example (line 298), not in the actual loaded patch file.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 的 prepare 钩子（运行构建流程），为标准 TypeScript 构建，无恶意载荷。
checked_items.en: The prepare hook in package.json (runs build process) was checked. It is a standard TypeScript build with no malicious payload.

checked_items.zh: 检查了测试脚本目录，其中 common.mjs 和 dsh-fixture.mjs 使用子进程调用 dsh CLI 和 pnpm，在隔离测试环境中运行，且代码显式清洗了凭据环境变量。
checked_items.en: The test script directory was checked. common.mjs and dsh-fixture.mjs use child processes to invoke dsh CLI and pnpm, running in an isolated test environment, and the code explicitly cleans credential environment variables.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 client 端键盘事件绑定（ComposerControl.tsx:129 的 Escape 关闭面板、SettingsPage.tsx:487 的 Escape 未保存提示），为标准 UI 交互，非键盘记录器。
checked_items.en: Client-side keyboard event bindings were checked (Escape in ComposerControl.tsx:129 closes panel, Escape in SettingsPage.tsx:487 prompts unsaved changes). These are standard UI interactions, not keyloggers.

evidence.zh: 实际加载的挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 无 !!js 标量（仅包含一个 insert 配置项）。PLAN.md 中的 !!js 出现在文档代码块中，不会被 loader 加载。
evidence.en: The actually loaded patch file cordis.patch.yml has no !!js scalar (it only contains one insert configuration item). The !!js in PLAN.md appears in a documentation code block and will not be loaded by the loader.

evidence.zh: 源代码中无动态包工具调用，无动态求值或外部进程调用。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tool invocation, dynamic evaluation, or external process invocation was found in the source code.

evidence.zh: prepare 钩子存在但内容为 tsdown + tsc 标准构建，无恶意代码。CI 工作流（.github/workflows/）为标准工程流水线，无外联/凭据读取行为。
evidence.en: The prepare hook exists but its content is a standard tsdown + tsc build, with no malicious code. The CI workflows (.github/workflows/) are standard engineering pipelines with no outbound connection or credential reading behavior.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器入口（client），client bundle 注入 UI 组件和键盘监听（均为标准 UI 交互），RPC 通道注册为仅限本地回环访问，无凭证设置调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser entry (client). The client bundle injects UI components and keyboard listeners (all standard UI interactions). The RPC channel is registered to be accessible only via local loopback, with no credential setting invocations.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源代码中是否存在网络请求、WebSocket、HTTP 客户端等网络调用，src/ 目录下无任何网络外联代码。
checked_items.en: All source code was checked for network requests, WebSocket, HTTP clients, and other network calls. No network outbound code exists under the src/ directory.

checked_items.zh: 检查了测试脚本中的网络调用，仅用于本地回环 RPC 通信和插件自身 tarball 下载（codeload.github.com）。
checked_items.en: Network calls in test scripts were checked. They are only for local loopback RPC communication and the plugin's own tarball download (codeload.github.com).

checked_items.zh: 检查了外联能力声明，插件声明 network: false，代码层面确认无网络外联。
checked_items.en: The outbound capability declaration was checked. The plugin declares network: false, and code inspection confirms no network outbound connections.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取与网络外发组合。插件无网络外联代码，无命令行外发。远程配方获取能力在服务端被永久禁用（src/rpc.ts:262-263，注释明确说明接受远程 URL 需要专门的防 SSRF 服务）。
evidence.en: No combination of credential reading and network exfiltration was found. The plugin has no network outbound code, and no command-line exfiltration. The remote recipe fetching capability is permanently disabled on the server side (src/rpc.ts:262-263, comments explicitly state that accepting remote URLs requires a dedicated anti-SSRF service).

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁是否触碰安全配置行（沙箱、审批、权限），补丁仅插入插件自身的配置行，无禁用项或降权写法。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration was checked for modification of security configuration lines (sandbox, approval, permissions). The patch only inserts the plugin's own configuration lines, with no disabled items or privilege-reducing modifications.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖项，运行时依赖使用语义化版本范围，开发依赖使用精确版本，均无浮动引用。
checked_items.en: Dependencies were checked. Runtime dependencies use semantic version ranges, development dependencies use exact versions, and no floating references were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否拦截安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求），未发现优先级监听导致审批链截断。
checked_items.en: The plugin was checked for interception of security events (tool pre-execution, approval requests). No priority listener leading to approval chain truncation was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了补丁是否改写服务注入/拦截配置，未发现此类操作。
checked_items.en: The patch was checked for rewriting of service injection/interception configuration. No such operation was found.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅插入 agent-team-gui 的配置行，不触及沙箱/审批/权限等安全行，无 disabled:true 或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only inserts configuration lines for agent-team-gui, does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions, and contains no disabled:true or environment variable privilege-reducing modifications.

evidence.zh: 插件使用常规事件监听（agent/pre-step），未使用优先级监听介入安全瀑布事件（工具预执行、审批请求）。
evidence.en: The plugin uses regular event listeners (agent/pre-step), not priority listeners that intervene in security waterfall events (tool pre-execution, approval requests).

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较。
evidence.en: First audit, no version baseline for comparison.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未改写服务注入/拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not rewrite service injection/interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动 Web 服务或监听网络端口，插件本身不启动 HTTP 服务器，RPC 处理器注册在宿主已有的本地回环通道上。
checked_items.en: The plugin was checked for starting a web service or listening on a network port. The plugin itself does not start an HTTP server; RPC handlers are registered on the host's existing local loopback channel.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 RPC 注册的权限声明，使用仅限本地回环的 authority 配置。
checked_items.en: The authority declaration for RPC registration was checked. It uses an authority configuration restricted to local loopback only.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务。RPC 处理器注册在宿主已有的连接通道上，且声明仅限本地回环访问。宿主 Web 服务的无认证 RPC 特性属生态固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service. RPC handlers are registered on the host's existing connection channel and declared to be accessible only via local loopback. The unauthenticated RPC feature of the host's web service is an inherent ecosystem risk, not a problem of this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据校验通过。package.json 包含 dsh 声明字段，插件身份与能力声明完整。
summary.en: Metadata validation passed. package.json contains the dsh declaration fields, and the plugin identity and capability declarations are complete.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：10 条规则命中全部经分析确认为良性工程行为，无恶意代码检出。
summary.en: Static scan completed: 10 rule hits were all analyzed and confirmed as benign engineering behavior, with no malicious code detected.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：安装钩子内容为标准构建脚本，无凭据读取或外联行为。
summary.en: Behavior analysis completed: The install hook content is a standard build script, with no credential reading or outbound connection behavior.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：工具描述和系统提示引导文本均为业务描述，无提示注入。
summary.en: AI metadata review completed: Tool descriptions and system prompt guidance text are all business descriptions, with no prompt injection.
Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed.

limits.zh: 动态沙箱验证（DG-L4）未执行，仅静态分析。静态扫描 10 条命中逐条裁决（全部良性排除，不产生审计发现）：DSH-X07 两条（DG-R3-59，.github/workflows/ci.yml 与 release-preflight.yml 为标准 CI 流水线，actions 全部 SHA 钉版、pnpm 安装使用 --ignore-scripts，无恶意内容）；DSH-X02（DG-R3-54，package.json:82 的 prepare 钩子运行 tsdown+tsc 标准构建）；DSH-P01（DG-R3-51，PLAN.md:298 的 !!js 位于文档代码块示例中，实际加载的 cordis.patch.yml 无 !!js）；DSH-X03 两条（DG-R3-55，scripts/quality/common.mjs 与 dsh-fixture.mjs 中的子进程调用属测试基础设施，且显式过滤凭据环境变量）；DSH-X05 两条（DG-R3-57，ComposerControl.tsx:129 与 SettingsPage.tsx:487 的键盘监听均为 UI Escape 交互，非键盘记录）；DSH-X08 两条（DG-R3-60，SettingsPage.tsx:345 与 styles.ts:20 的超长行为紧凑 JSX/CSS 排版，非混淆代码，无混淆器签名）。未发现 SKILL.md/AGENTS.md 等模型面指令文件。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification (DG-L4) was not executed, only static analysis was performed. Static scan 10 hits adjudicated one by one (all benign excluded, no audit findings produced): DSH-X07 two items (DG-R3-59, .github/workflows/ci.yml and release-preflight.yml are standard CI pipelines, all actions pinned by SHA, pnpm install uses --ignore-scripts, no malicious content); DSH-X02 (DG-R3-54, prepare hook at package.json:82 runs standard tsdown+tsc build); DSH-P01 (DG-R3-51, !!js in PLAN.md:298 is in a documentation code block example, the actual loaded cordis.patch.yml has no !!js); DSH-X03 two items (DG-R3-55, subprocess calls in scripts/quality/common.mjs and dsh-fixture.mjs are test infrastructure and explicitly filter credential environment variables); DSH-X05 two items (DG-R3-57, keyboard listeners in ComposerControl.tsx:129 and SettingsPage.tsx:487 are both UI Escape interactions, not keyloggers); DSH-X08 two items (DG-R3-60, long lines in SettingsPage.tsx:345 and styles.ts:20 are compact JSX/CSS formatting, not obfuscated code, no obfuscator signature). No model-facing instruction files such as SKILL.md/AGENTS.md were found.
